name: BfsCountryCodes
title: ISO 3166 country codes from the BFS list
description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes of the valid states and territories in the list of states and territories (Verzeichnis der Staaten und Gebiete) of the Swiss Federal Statistical Office (BFS), release of 22.05.2024 ([be-b-00.04-sg-01](https://statistik.admin.ch/de/asset/32028071)). Combines the BFS state codes and BFS territory codes value sets.
